 inspection, quality control general director and supervisor of inspection & 
 quality control's head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy, 
 safety shoes, ...etc.
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy, 
 safety shoes, ...etc.
Isolate the 
 circuit breaker of the pump motor.
Disconnect 
 electric terminals of the pump motor.
The pump must 
 be isolated mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves.
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Vibrometer, Feeler gauge, dial indicator.
Cleaning fluid.
Work to be Carried Out
Before Pump Shut Down
Check discharge pressure and compare them with the setting value.
Measure vibration level of the thrust bearing, compare it with the setting 
 value, then analyze it and determine what to do ( if it is needed ).
Check the temperature of the thrust bearing and compare it with the normal 
 value.
Pump Shut Down
Check alignment and compare it with the setting value.
Check the bolts fixation, then re-tightens ( if it is needed ).
Check the level and validity of oil and add or change ( if it is needed ).
Check the gland for leaking and re-packing ( if it is needed ) .
Check flanges for leaking.
Check the pump casing against rust and re-paint ( if it is needed )
